A reviewer wrote that names like Root, Admin, Null, and Main are role words in this fixture, not people. The generated person span is Alice Parker. Values like support@example.invalid and 555-0100 appear only in instructions, while generated contact labels are wilburn@example.com and 555-0139. The generated postal clue is 54290-4105, and the generated source address is 2001:db8:395d:ebf8::a20b. This makes name-like and contact-like distractors explicit.
